lines.notes: Soorghat is shown between Jagatpur–Wazirabad and Nanaksar–Sonia Vihar on the official map. The map, marked August 2026, records 45 operating Pink stations and one station under construction. No later passenger-opening confirmation was found in this review, so Soorghat remains separately flagged and excluded from the verified operating count. The review does not establish its live gate or boarding status on 17 October 2026.

notices.title: Soorghat is excluded
notices.body: The source map lists 45 operating Pink stations. A later passenger opening for Soorghat has not been confirmed.

notices.title: Magenta has two separate sections
notices.body: Krishna Park Extension–Botanical Garden and Deepali Chowk–Majlis Park are routed separately. There is no invented link across the unfinished gap.

notices.title: Different networks, separate fares
notices.body: Namo Bharat, Aqua and Rapid Metro connections may require leaving the paid area and buying another ticket. Follow signs at interchanges.

notices.title: Plan offline. Confirm before travelling.
